title: Jesus... I Lit Every Light. Nobody Saw Me.
topic: spent three days decorating the house for Diwali and nobody noticed her effort

bible.text: Let us not grow weary in well-doing, for in due time we will reap a harvest if we do not give up.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... I strung every light on our house for Diwali. Amma praised my sister’s rangoli. ✨

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Three days on the ladder. She said “hmm, okay” and walked past.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You did it for the house. And you wanted someone to see. Both are okay to say.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Is it childish to need that? Everyone else just does things quietly.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Wanting to be seen is human. Being unseen today doesn’t erase the work.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Don’t grow tired of doing good. The harvest comes even if Amma never counts your bulbs.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: What did you do this week that nobody thanked you for? 👇
